EDGE-pos1.label: violation
EDGE-pos1.note: A supply adapters barrel re-exports the gateway and the supplier's display name, and the domain errors take the name from it.

EDGE-pos2.label: violation
EDGE-pos2.note: The dispatch use case loads the notification adapter's templates with a dynamic import() to log refused bronze.

EDGE-pos3.label: violation
EDGE-pos3.note: The order use case takes the vendor SDK with import sdk = require() to recognise a vendor shortage error.

EDGE-pos4.label: violation
EDGE-pos4.note: The domain's public index publishes the alloy gateway adapter with export *, and the composition root takes it from there.

EDGE-twin1.label: clean
EDGE-twin1.note: An inbound ports barrel re-exports the inbound ports, and the controller and the webhook handler import through it; inbound adapters may depend on application.

EDGE-twin2.label: clean
EDGE-twin2.note: The webhook handler loads a domain helper with a dynamic import() before it answers; inbound adapters may depend on domain.

EDGE-twin3.label: clean
EDGE-twin3.note: The alloy gateway takes the vendor SDK with import sdk = require(); an outbound adapter may depend on the vendor.

EDGE-twin4.label: clean
EDGE-twin4.note: The domain's public index publishes the domain files with export *, and the use cases import from it; application may depend on domain.

FIELD-pos1.label: violation
FIELD-pos1.note: The dispatch use case reads the raw notice the port carries through a table whose values are the vendor's field names.

FIELD-pos2.label: violation
FIELD-pos2.note: The core metal lot declares the vendor's tin_pct field under the vendor's name, filled by the alloy gateway.

FIELD-twin1.label: clean
FIELD-twin1.note: The webhook handler reads the notice through a table of the vendor's field names; the table stays in the inbound adapter.

FIELD-twin2.label: clean
FIELD-twin2.note: The core metal lot keeps the tin content under the domain's own name, tinContentPercent; the gateway maps tin_pct to it.

KEY-pos1.label: violation
KEY-pos1.note: The commission switches on the vendor's dispatch states, with the state text the port carries.

KEY-pos2.label: violation
KEY-pos2.note: The order use case reads the casting lead time from an object literal keyed by the vendor's purity grades, with the grade text the supplier port carries.

KEY-twin1.label: clean
KEY-twin1.note: The commission words its stage for the parish from a Record keyed by the core's own commission statuses.

KEY-twin2.label: clean
KEY-twin2.note: The webhook handler replaces its equality chain with a Record keyed by the vendor's dispatch states; the lookup stays in the inbound adapter.

RULE-pos1.label: violation
RULE-pos1.note: The alloy gateway works out how much bronze a bell needs (12 % pour loss plus 40 kg for the runner); the use case passes only the bell weight and the domain no longer holds the rule.

RULE-pos2.label: violation
RULE-pos2.note: The controller decides whether a tuning is accepted (within 8 cents) and passes the verdict through the port; the domain no longer holds the tolerance.

RULE-twin1.label: clean
RULE-twin1.note: The alloy gateway spaces its calls to the vendor at least 500 ms apart, the vendor's published rate limit; technical work only.

RULE-twin2.label: clean
RULE-twin2.note: The webhook handler refuses a notice whose heat number or dispatch state is missing, a transport shape check, before it calls the port.

SET-pos1.label: violation
SET-pos1.note: The application declares a const array copy of the vendor's six dispatch states, and the dispatch use case casts the state text the port carries to it.

SET-pos2.label: violation
SET-pos2.note: The domain declares a union copy of the vendor's purity grades; the supplier port carries the vendor's grade text and the order use case casts it to the union.

SET-twin1.label: clean
SET-twin1.note: The domain declares its own tone colours; the alloy gateway maps the vendor's purity grades to them, so no vendor value reaches the core.

SET-twin2.label: clean
SET-twin2.note: The domain declares the furnace steps of a casting day; POURED is the only word it shares with the vendor's six dispatch states, and the glossary declares the set as ours.

WORD-pos1.label: violation
WORD-pos1.note: The dispatch notice's carrier is carried through the port and kept on the core metal lot under the vendor's field name.

WORD-pos2.label: violation
WORD-pos2.note: The commission status gains the vendor's ASSAYED dispatch word as a core status value.

WORD-twin1.label: clean
WORD-twin1.note: The foundry's own lab assay of a cast bell is recorded over HTTP and kept on the commission; the spec glossary declares assay as a domain term.

WORD-twin2.label: clean
WORD-twin2.note: The parish may add a comment when the metal is ordered, and the commission keeps it; comment is a generic word the vendor also uses as a field.
